```yaml
name: Auto-Merge Release Branch

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 4 * * *' # Runs daily at 4am UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  auto-merge:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: cargo build --workspace --all-targets --verbose

      - name: Check for open release->main PR
        id: check-pr
        run: |
          PR=$(gh pr list --state open --base main --head release --json number | jq -r '.[0].number')
          echo "::set-output name=pr::$PR"

      - name: Merge PR if exists
        if: steps.check-pr.outputs.pr != ''
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=${{ steps.check-pr.outputs.pr }}
          gh pr merge $PR_NUMBER --merge --auto --commit-message "Auto-merge release into main" --author mise-en-dev
          echo "Merge successful"
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Handle merge conflict
        if: always() && failure()
        run: echo "Merge conflict detected, skipping merge"
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Log completion
        run: echo "Auto-merge process completed"
```
